name: fandango-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for Fandango movie showtimes and seat availability.
long_description: Local, read-only MCP server for Fandango built from observed web traffic. It searches movie showtimes across nearby theaters, reads theater calendars and theater-specific showtimes, fetches seat availability by showtimeHashCode, and renders terminal-friendly seat maps. It never buys, reserves, holds, validates, favorites, or checks out tickets.

tools.name: fandango_movie_showtimes
tools.description: Find one movie's showtimes across nearby theaters for one date.

tools.name: fandango_theater_showtimes
tools.description: Find one theater's movie showtimes for one date.

tools.name: fandango_theater_calendar
tools.description: Read which dates currently have showtimes for one theater.

tools.name: fandango_seat_availability
tools.description: Read normalized open/taken seat availability for one showtimeHashCode.

tools.name: fandango_scan_movie_availability
tools.description: Scan one movie across nearby theaters and dates, optionally with seat counts.

tools.name: fandango_render_seat_map
tools.description: Render a showtime seat map as terminal-friendly Unicode boxes.

user_agent.title: User-Agent
user_agent.description: Optional browser User-Agent override matching captured Fandango traffic.
